## Built: 3D MMA Fighting Game

Created a complete playable browser game with:

- Large 3D arena environment
- Full octagon cage with posts and rails
- Audience tiers, arena lighting, fog, and atmospheric effects
- Playable 3D fighter models
- Fighter selection roster with 16 UFC legends
- Health and stamina systems
- AI opponent with attack timing and blocking response
- Fight timer and round HUD
- Match feed
- Victory/defeat states
- Rematch button
- Responsive mobile layout
- Keyboard and on-screen controls

### Controls

- `W A S D` — Move
- `J` — Jab
- `K` — Heavy strike
- `Space` — Block
- On-screen buttons also work

### Files added

- `index.html`
- `styles.css`
- `app.js`

### Verification

- JavaScript syntax checked successfully
- Served locally and loaded successfully
- Captured and inspected a 1280×720 JPEG screenshot at `/tmp/opencode/octagon.jpg`
